steps.context: 12000 x 10 raw integer Salmon gene counts, 5 treated vs 5 control, unpaired, single batch. sample_03 flagged as an outlier by T1S1's QC.

MA plot and dispersion plot produced for each fit

State explicitly that the enrichment result is method-dependent (ORA only was permitted for this design) and should not be read as the sole functional interpretation
acceptance_criteria: Report states method, package versions, design formula, contrast, thresholds (padj<0.05), number of genes tested after filtering, and number of DE genes for both the primary and sensitivity fits

Reproducibility record included: session info, package versions, gene set collection versions, and any random seeds used

plan.title: Treated vs control muscle RNA-seq DE with outlier sensitivity check
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 10 muscle samples (5 treated, 5 control), unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts across 12,000 genes. The profile flags sample_03 as a PCA/distance-heatmap outlier. Rather than silently drop it, the plan runs QC first to characterize the outlier's technical signature (library size, detected genes), then fits DESeq2 twice — once on all 10 samples (primary) and once excluding sample_03 (sensitivity) — and reports both gene lists with their overlap, per the knowledge-service rule that an unexplained sample removal must not silently determine the result. Genes are called by DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm-shrunken log2FC, BH-adjusted p<0.05 with independent filtering. Because the smallest significant gene list may fall below the ~50-gene threshold needed for a well-powered over-representation test (the knowledge check rejected preranked fgsea for this n=5/5 design and permitted only over-representation analysis with an explicit universe), pathway interpretation uses clusterProfiler ORA against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome gene sets (both staged locally for human), with the universe restricted to tested genes, run separately for the primary and sensitivity gene lists.

steps.method: vst(blind) + PCA + sample distance heatmap + library size/detected-gene check
keep genes with >=10 counts in >=5 samples (smallest group size)
~condition, explicit reference level = control, contrast treated vs control
DESeq2 Wald test, run with all 10 samples (primary) and again with sample_03 excluded (sensitivity), report both
fgsea preranked on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
DE report with both fits, overlap, diagnostics, leading edge
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column), full ranked gene list, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome collections, min_size=15, max_size=500, BH-adjusted
Over-representation analysis (clusterProfiler enricher) on the significant gene list (padj<0.05) against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome, universe = tested genes
